user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Successful logout
steps: User clicks on the logout button
User is redirected to the login page
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and the session is ended.

positive.title: Logout confirmation message
steps: User clicks on the logout button
User sees a confirmation message that the logout was successful
positive.expected_result: A confirmation message is displayed to the user indicating they have successfully logged out.

negative.title: Logout when not logged in
steps: User navigates to the logout URL without being logged in
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message indicating that they must be logged in to log out.

negative.title: Session timeout before logout
steps: User is logged in and idle for longer than the session timeout
User attempts to click on the logout button
negative.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page with an error message indicating the session has expired.

edge.title: Logout while performing an action
steps: User is in the middle of submitting a form
edge.expected_result: Form submission is cancelled, and user is logged out successfully without any data loss.

edge.title: Multiple logout attempts
steps: User clicks the logout button once
User quickly clicks the logout button again before the action completes
edge.expected_result: User is logged out successfully, and the second click does not produce an error.
